FlowStore.startRun(session) → RunStore
the flow hands each run its own store; the run never learns about the flow or the run before it

span.p:
subscribe (run commits bubble up) · delegating setters (run keys go down)
FlowStore.setRunPhase, setTasks, requestQuestion, … act on the active run, adding the interrupt and analytics

WizardUI (StoreUI writes) · RunStateSource (the stream reads) · run.session (the agent reads)
three consumers of one RunStore; none of them can see another run
